newsitem.title: USA: Omnipoint begins wireless PCS in New York.
newsitem.headline: Omnipoint begins wireless PCS in New York.

text.p: Omnipoint Corp on Thursday said it had launched its Personal Communications Services (PCS) digital mobile phone service in metropolitan New York, with packages starting from $19.99 per month and going up to $39.99 per month.

Omnipoint said the service offers greater clarity than analog cellular services with fewer dropped calls. The new small phones' capabilities include e-mail, voice mail, faxmail, pager services, as well as longer battery life than existing cellular phones.
The company has three plans, basic costing $19.99 per month and giving the user a built-in answering machine, numerical paging, short e-mail and call waiting and forwarding.
Omnipoint said it will sell a variety of handsets from manufacturers like Ericsson, Motorola and Nokia, with suggested retail prices starting at $199.

Rates for calls start at $0.25 per minute for local calls made between 2100 and 0659 and on weekends. Calls for anywhere in the United States and Canada are $0.69 per minute. International calls range from $0.99 per minute to $1.99 per minute.
